rules.description: Suppress import-only claims that a package may be missing unless manifest evidence is present.
text_any: \b(?:not|isn'?t|missing|absent|without)\b.{0,80}\b(?:dependenc|package\.json|lockfile|installed|listed)\b
\bimport(?:ed)?\b.{0,80}\bmay not be installed\b

rules.description: Suppress purely subjective visual polish concerns unless a functional/accessibility break is identified.
text_any: \b(?:text-shadow|shadow|tooltip width|truncate|truncation|line-clamp|wrapping|visual inconsistency|polish|align properly|may not align)\b

rules.description: Suppress the SQL misconception that MAX/MIN with GROUP BY needs ORDER BY for deterministic aggregate values.
text_all: \border by\b.{0,100}\bdetermin|determin.{0,100}\border by\b|lacks? an order by|without an order by

rules.description: Suppress endpoint-missing claims for paths already matched by deterministic related-service evidence.
text_any: \b(?:backend|route|endpoint|api)\b.{0,120}\b(?:may not|might not|does not|not support|missing|not found)\b

rules.description: Suppress claims that MAX(id) or ID ordering may not mean most recent unless the input shows a competing timestamp/business recency field.
text_any: \b(?:id order|MAX\(id\)|max id|id)\b.{0,160}\b(?:not monotonically increasing|not monotonic|does not reflect recency|stale|outdated|most recent|latest)\b
\b(?:location_level_id|MAX\(location_level_id\)|max location_level_id)\b.{0,160}\b(?:not monotonically increasing|not monotonic|does not reflect recency|stale|outdated|most recent|latest)\b

rules.description: Suppress generic timezone/day-boundary claims when temporal UI code is present but no explicit UTC/server timezone contract is shown.
text_any: \b(?:timezone|time zone|utc|local time|server time|day-end|day end|timestamp)\b.{0,220}\b(?:incorrect|invalid|wrong|block valid|allow invalid|different timezone|different time zone)\b
\b(?:incorrect|invalid|wrong|block valid|allow invalid)\b.{0,220}\b(?:timezone|time zone|utc|local time|server time|day-end|day end|timestamp)\b

rules.description: Suppress parameterization/dynamic-label preferences unless backed by a requirement, accessibility, i18n, or wrong-value proof.
text_any: \b(?:hardcoded|static)\b.{0,160}\b(?:label|title|tooltip|text|copy)\b.{0,160}\b(?:may not reflect|might not reflect|should vary|should be parameterized|intended dynamic)\b
\b(?:label|title|tooltip|text|copy)\b.{0,160}\b(?:should vary|should be parameterized|intended dynamic)\b

rules.description: Suppress pointer-events speculation unless the finding proves a concrete click, hover, focus, overlay, or stacking failure.
text_any: \bpointer-events-(?:none|auto)\b.{0,220}\b(?:can cause|could cause|may cause|might cause|subtle interaction|captures pointer|capture pointer)\b
\b(?:can cause|could cause|may cause|might cause|subtle interaction|captures pointer|capture pointer)\b.{0,220}\bpointer-events-(?:none|auto)\b

rules.description: Suppress default-value product expectation claims unless they cite a requirement, previous behavior, regression, or real functional impact.
text_any: \bdefault\b.{0,180}\b(?:may not match|might not match|user expectations|product requirements|intended default|broader|historical)\b
\b(?:user expectations|product requirements|intended default)\b.{0,180}\bdefault\b

rules.description: Suppress .toString() type-guard speculation unless the input proves a nullable/unknown/union type or concrete runtime failure.
text_any: \btoString\(\).{0,320}\b(?:type is not verified|not verified|type guard|validation|could cause runtime errors|may cause runtime errors|incorrect behavior)\b
\b(?:type is not verified|not verified|type guard|validation|could cause runtime errors|may cause runtime errors|incorrect behavior)\b.{0,320}\btoString\(\)\b

rules.description: Suppress backend/API/contract compatibility claims unless related-service repository evidence was included in the review input.
text_any: \b(?:backend|server|api|endpoint|route|contract|response shape|request parameter)\b.{0,220}\b(?:may not|might not|does not|not support|missing|not found|not confirmed|verify|confirm|unverified|compatible|compatibility|mismatch)\b

\b(?:may not|might not|does not|not support|missing|not found|not confirmed|verify|confirm|unverified|compatible|compatibility|mismatch)\b.{0,220}\b(?:backend|server|api|endpoint|route|contract|response shape|request parameter)\b

rules.description: Suppress route warnings based only on the related-service evidence not containing an exact path.
text_any: \brelated-service evidence\b.{0,160}\b(?:does not contain|doesn't contain|does not include|not include|not found|does not have)\b.{0,120}\b(?:path|route|endpoint)\b
\b(?:path|route|endpoint)\b.{0,120}\brelated-service evidence\b.{0,160}\b(?:does not contain|doesn't contain|does not include|not include|not found|does not have)\b

rules.description: Suppress findings that only ask to confirm backend response shape, field shape, or route support without proof of a mismatch.
text_any: \b(?:confirm|verify)\b.{0,120}\bbackend\b.{0,160}\b(?:response|contract|route|support|structure|shape|includes?)\b
\bbackend\b.{0,160}\b(?:not confirmed|contract not confirmed|response structure|field shape)\b

rules.description: Suppress findings that only ask whether a navigation/field-label product change is intentional.
text_any: \b(?:confirm|verify)\b.{0,120}\b(?:intentional|aligns? with product strategy|existing workflows|product strategy)\b
\b(?:removing user access|changed displayed field|changed field names?)\b.{0,160}\b(?:confirm|verify)\b

rules.description: Suppress claims that changing a UI link from an external base URL to a relative path may need cross-origin routing unless config evidence proves it.
text_any: \b(?:PMS_UI_URL|base url|cross-origin|cross origin)\b.{0,160}\b(?:verify|required|may|might|support)\b
\b(?:verify|required|may|might|support)\b.{0,160}\b(?:PMS_UI_URL|base url|cross-origin|cross origin)\b
